name: freMTPL2freq
description: The dataset freMTPL2freq contains risk features for 677,991 motor third-part liability policies (observed mostly on one year). See https://github.com/dutangc/CASdatasets for more details. The dataset is associated with 'Computational Actuarial Science with R' edited by Arthur Charpentier, CRC, 2018.
citation: C. Dutang and A. Charpentier (2018), CASdatasets: Insurance datasets.
